bosses.name: Lady Anacondra
bosses.general: Druid of the Fang: Lightning Bolt, Sleep on one of us, and Healing Touch on herself.
bosses.tank: Pull her out of sight round a corner so she comes to you.
bosses.healer: Dispel the Sleep if you can, heal the bolts.
bosses.dps: Interrupt every Healing Touch, then burn her.

bosses.name: Lord Cobrahn
bosses.general: Lightning Bolt and Sleep, poisons, and at low health he turns into a big serpent that hits much harder.
bosses.tank: Keep him in melee; be ready for the serpent form near the end.
bosses.healer: Cure the poison and save mana for his serpent form.
bosses.dps: Interrupt his heals and burn him fast once he changes form.

bosses.name: Lord Pythas
bosses.general: Lightning Bolt, Sleep and Healing Touch, and a Thunderclap on the melee.
bosses.tank: Keep him in melee, face him away from the casters.
bosses.healer: Dispel Sleep, heal the Thunderclap damage.

bosses.name: Lord Serpentis
bosses.general: The last Fanglord: Lightning Bolt, Sleep and Healing Touch.
bosses.tank: Pull him away from the other druids.
bosses.healer: Dispel Sleep on whoever he puts down.

bosses.name: Kresh
bosses.general: Big turtle in the water. Harmless, kill it or swim past.

bosses.name: Skum
bosses.general: Thunder lizard in the water: Chained Bolt jumps between players standing close.
bosses.dps: Ranged spread out so the bolt doesn't chain.

bosses.name: Verdan the Everliving
bosses.general: Giant plant: Grasping Vines knock down everyone near him.
bosses.tank: Keep him on you and expect to be knocked down.
bosses.healer: Stay out of the vines' reach, heal the tank.
bosses.dps: Ranged keep their distance; melee heal up between knockdowns.

bosses.name: Mutanus the Devourer
bosses.general: Comes after the waves of Naralex's awakening. Terrify fears, Naralex's Nightmare sleeps, Thundercrack stuns.
bosses.tank: Keep him on you through the fear; Berserker Rage or Tremor help.
bosses.healer: Dispel the Nightmare sleep, keep the tank up during fears.
bosses.dps: Burn him, he is the end of the dungeon.

bosses.name: Deviate Faerie Dragon
bosses.general: Rare: Arcane Explosion around itself and Sleep.
bosses.healer: Dispel Sleep; heal the melee through Arcane Explosion.
bosses.dps: Ranged are safer; melee watch their health.
